svg.title: Building and restoring the dataset
svg.desc: The owner checkpoints and snapshots the database, verifies the copy and records its checksum, then builds data.zip from the latest snapshot, both vector files, the CNA cache and the aspect answers. A teammate or assessor puts data.zip at data/data.zip; Docker setup, or the same script run natively, checks it and restores the missing files.
